failure_signature.detail: After installing the pinned JAX stack, pip build isolation returned no available version for setuptools>=61.0. The same submitted script had just passed advisory fresh replay.

causal_disposition.reason: The frozen protocol counts the primary Official outcome as Fail, but equivalent empty-setuptools candidate failures have been intermittent and unresolved. Do not derive a new operation rule without deterministic reproduction.

deployment_completeness.reason: Even if the missing-import objective passed, thirteen packages were installed with --no-deps, so transitive runtime completeness would remain unestablished.
